title: Experimenting with Gouache
content: Gouache presents at least five difficulties: it freezes, it dries fast, it reactivates, it looks chalky, and it shifts values when it dries. I face each of these challenges, answering viewer questions as I paint Hudson River iceboats and chart the properties of gouache, casein, and acrylic.Here's a one-hour long workshop on YouTube.The full 93 minute tutorial is video available from:GumroadandSellfy.
